statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the currently selected newsgroup is valid, the current article number MUST be set to the next article in that newsgroup (that is, the lowest existing article number greater than the current article number).
actions: set current article number to the lowest existing article number greater than the current article number

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If successful, a response indicating the new current article number and the message-id of that article MUST be returned.
statements.post_cond: response.sent = true & response.includes_new_article_number = true & response.includes_message_id = true
actions: return response indicating new current article number and message-id of that article

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the current article number is already the last article of the newsgroup, a 421 response MUST be returned.
